obligations.blocked_transition: publish or consume a law under a competing contract identity
obligations.recovery: restore the one promise-machine/v1 contract identity and rerun the obligation check

obligations.blocked_transition: admit source-linked chunks as retrieval input
obligations.recovery: return to the cited source bytes

obligations.blocked_transition: admit recorded RPC evidence to the pinned answer evidence set
obligations.recovery: run the named proof checker for the exact fixture

obligations.blocked_transition: bind the promoted Berean release digest to its declared evidence
obligations.recovery: inspect the pinned corpus, answers, and evaluation record

obligations.blocked_transition: bind the bounded Janus result to its host-specific evidence
obligations.recovery: rerun against the named host adapter and bounded manifest

obligations.blocked_transition: consume the verified statement as an artefact-evidence binding
obligations.recovery: run an external signature verifier bound to the statement

obligations.blocked_transition: admit the checked observation prefix to the named comparison cohort
obligations.recovery: return to the validator, capture, and bound receipt

obligations.blocked_transition: consume the recomputable comparison as bounded integration evidence
obligations.recovery: inspect the cohort, findings, report, counterevidence, and unknown runs

obligations.blocked_transition: accept an authored law that omits a required promise declaration field
obligations.recovery: restore all nine required schema fields and rerun the obligation check

obligations.blocked_transition: run a core checker capable of network, credential, shell, subprocess, dynamic-code or evidence-command access
obligations.recovery: remove the forbidden import or call and rerun the offline core-checker guard

obligations.blocked_transition: authorise a transition through an unresolved, mismatched, expired or revoked exception
obligations.recovery: restore a digest-bound authority and reason record, matching promise, gate, subject and scope, valid expiry and explicit revocation state

obligations.blocked_transition: publish generated installation copies without the canonical-source identity
obligations.recovery: restore the canonical generated-copy marker, regenerate copies, and rerun the obligation check

obligations.blocked_transition: accept an authored law whose governing-principle sentence changed
obligations.recovery: restore the settled governing-principle sentence and rerun the obligation check

obligations.blocked_transition: emit or consume an incomplete refusal record
obligations.recovery: restore the complete refusal fields and render text and JSON again from the same finding

obligations.blocked_transition: accept a root law with a missing or duplicated normative section
obligations.recovery: restore every required heading exactly once and rerun the obligation check

obligations.blocked_transition: authorise a positive transition from unknown, not-run, missing, stale or unresolved evidence
obligations.recovery: record resolved positive evidence for the same subject and scope, preserve remaining unknowns, and rerun the transition check

obligations.blocked_transition: authorise a transition without its consequence-specific evidence path
obligations.recovery: supply the exact evidence required by the declared consequence and rerun the transition check

obligations.blocked_transition: accept a level-two or level-three result without its source-bound native fields
obligations.recovery: restore the bounded reader, native fields, source digest, and level-three authority evidence, then rerun the runtime check
